answer: A farm of 190 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in umber, queued in relic, and ridge publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 98 identities per epoch. A farm of 1115 identities would post 2021 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
